{{Top|leg}}
'''Delgad''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Upon hearing from fellow commenters [[Vox (Cynabar's Droid Datalog)|Vox]] and [[Ransom (Cynabar's Droid Datalog)|Ransom]] that the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] had deployed [[Class I Defense Droid]] against the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]], Delgad sarcastically noted that [[Imperial HoloVision]] had failed to mention it.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
